title: Ten years, iii
source: lore/drift_wood/_THE_COMPLETE_RUN.md (Ten Years Under the Table · deepening)
logline: Wednesday. The mudflats. Wood carries him across the channel he used to jump. Neither of them remarks on it. The strip is previewing 2014 without knowing.

panels.composition: The mudflats, low tide, a channel a yard wide. BARNABY at its edge. WOOD beside him.

image.prompt: brush-pen line with muddy early-digital flat color, tidal mudflats at low tide with a narrow water channel, an old dog standing at its edge and a thin man beside it

panels.composition: The dog looking at the channel. Ten years of jumping it. Not today.

image.prompt: brush-pen line with muddy early-digital flat color, close-up of an old dog looking at a narrow channel of water it cannot jump, no words

panels.composition: Wood lifting him. The way you lift a dog who has never been lifted: badly, then right.

image.prompt: brush-pen line with muddy early-digital flat color, a thin man lifting an old dog awkwardly and then properly against his chest on mudflats, no words

panels.composition: Wood crossing the channel with the dog, from behind, the flats, the chimney across the bay. 'The Carry,' five years early, in the wrong line.

image.prompt: brush-pen line with muddy early-digital flat color, a thin man seen from behind carrying an old dog across a tidal channel on mudflats with a distant chimney across the bay, no words
image.notes: The composition of dw_2014-11-16 in Era II's line. Unknowing.

art.line: brush-pen; the flats cleaner; the Sundays the point now

notes: Carried across the channel. 'The Carry' previewed in the wrong line.
